name: Elixir of Agony
summary: Apothecary Lydon’s work in Tarren Mill reaches a deadly test. His Elixir of Agony is ready, and he sends Horde champions to Dun Garok for a keg of Shindigger Stout.

sections.title: A Bitter Brew
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon serves the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas in Tarren Mill. He has gathered lethal ingredients from across Hillsbrad and finished a new concoction. Frogs and stray dogs are no test for its strength. Lydon wants to see what it does to living adversaries.

sections.title: Infiltrating Dun Garok
sections.body: Lydon needs a quiet way to carry his experiment. South of Hillsbrad, Ironforge dwarves hold the fortified stronghold of Dun Garok. He sends Horde agents into its underground barracks and mess halls to slip past dwarven rifles and axes and steal a keg of Shindigger Stout.

sections.title: A Recipe for Disaster
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon plans to mix his toxin into the dwarves’ favorite brew. The stolen keg can carry the elixir to an unwitting target, disguised as festive refreshment. A beloved dwarven stout becomes a vessel for agony.

faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon is a Forsaken alchemist stationed in Tarren Mill. He represents the Royal Apothecary Society and experiments with deadly plagues and elixirs for the Banshee Queen, Lady Sylvanas.

faq.q: Why does Lydon need a keg of Shindigger Stout?
faq.answer: Lydon wants to test his finished Elixir of Agony on living targets. Mixing it into a keg of popular dwarven ale gives him a covert way to poison his victims.

aliases: where do i find the keg
faq.answer: Dun Garok lies in southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills. Ironforge mountaineers and riflemen man the fortified redoubt and guard their northern interests.
Umpi is Apothecary Lydon’s assistant in Tarren Mill. Lydon says that opening jars of formaldehyde around the lab makes Umpi visibly nervous.

faq.q: What is the ultimate goal of the Elixir of Agony?
aliases: what does elixir of agony do
faq.answer: The Elixir of Agony is an experimental poison the Royal Apothecary Society made to eradicate the living. It serves the Forsaken campaign to secure Lordaeron from human and dwarven footholds.

faq.q: What comes next after retrieving the keg?
faq.answer: With the keg in hand, Lydon mixes the toxic elixir into the Shindigger Stout and sends you to deliver the tainted ale to an unsuspecting test subject.

angles.text: As an Undead, you see each batch Lydon perfects bring the Forsaken closer to using death against the living enemies encroaching on Lordaeron.
As a Dwarf, you know that turning traditional dwarven ale into a vessel for chemical slaughter insults Ironforge craftsmanship.
As Horde, you help undermine the Alliance presence at Dun Garok, where Tarren Mill holds a delicate foothold against relentless southern threats.
As a Rogue, you slip through Dun Garok’s crowded mess halls unseen, stealing under the mountaineers’ noses.
